items.t: Cam phaser and timing chain rattle
items.job: Replace cam phasers, timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Owners report an average of about $3,000 for the power-loss repair. Costs rise if the engine was damaged.

items.t: Spark plugs break off during removal
items.job: Replace spark plugs and extract broken plugs
items.note: A normal plug change averages about $618. Owners paid about $600-2,000 when plugs broke, and the head may need to come off in the worst case.

items.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil or plug boot
items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plug boot (one cylinder or full set)
items.note: A single coil is at the low end; all eight coils average about $700 in parts.

items.t: Engine loses power or runs poorly
items.note: RepairPal lists about $540-663. If the cam phasers are the cause, see that repair instead.

items.t: Erratic fuel gauge with check engine light
items.job: Replace fuel pump and level sender module
items.note: A dealer may fix it with a cluster or wiring repair instead, which costs less.

items.t: Power steering pressure line seeps fluid in cold weather
items.note: Based on the same-platform Ford F-150.
